People see only the work they are part of, when you decide a company should work that way.

## What's in 1.13.0

**Need-to-know visibility.** On the Groups page, an owner or admin can switch a company from open, where everyone sees every project and task, to need-to-know. Operators and viewers then see the projects of their groups and the tasks they are involved in: the ones they created, are assigned to, are responsible for or chat in, with every subtask beneath. A group with **Sees everything in the company** ticked keeps its members unrestricted, and owners and admins always see everything.

**Everything follows the same rule.** Search finds only what the person may see, live updates carry only ids, and a task or subtask can be created only where the person can see. Opening a hidden task or project, by id or by its `PREFIX-17` identifier, answers "not found", the same as for one that does not exist. Pages that are company-wide by nature, such as Activity, Approvals and Costs, refuse a restricted person rather than showing a partial view. Agents working for a restricted person see what that person sees during the run.

**Groups carry projects.** Each group's form has a **Projects** picker. In a need-to-know company, a group's members see those projects and everything in them.

**Switching is deliberate.** Switching to need-to-know first lists who becomes restricted and asks you to confirm, and it needs a valid licence. Switching back to open never does. Every company starts open, so nothing changes until you switch one.

**You can check it.** `kyoube doctor` prints a `visibility` line for the instance and one per need-to-know company, and fails if the core's shadow authorization variables are set. The full model, including what is not covered, is in [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/KyoubeAI/KyoubeAI/blob/main/SECURITY.md#visibility).

**Smaller things.** The image carries `libatomic1`, which the Node 26 builds that harness installers such as Hermes download need. `install.sh` refuses an address that is not a full `http://` or `https://` URL before writing it, instead of leaving the core to refuse it at startup.

## Update

From 1.12, run `./update.sh`. It backs up first, and `./update.sh --rollback` returns to 1.12.1. One plugin migration runs when the groups plugin starts: it adds a visibility mode per company, a flag per group and a table of group projects, all of which the older version ignores. Four plugins move to new versions on the first start. Afterwards, the `visibility` line of `kyoube doctor` should read `open everywhere`.

How need-to-know works, what a restricted person sees and what it does not cover is in [docs/groups.md](https://github.com/KyoubeAI/KyoubeAI/blob/main/docs/groups.md#visibility). The full list of changes is in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/KyoubeAI/KyoubeAI/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
